section_summary: This section documents the financial conditions, annual budgetary planning, and major public development works of Taiwan under Japanese administration between April 1930 and May 1935. It consists primarily of consular despatches and detailed statistical reports from the American Consulate at Taihoku tracking the colonial government's revenues, monopoly operations, retrenchment policies, and infrastructure spending. It also includes diplomatic correspondence and corporate prospectuses concerning an American bond flotation of $22,800,000 for the Taiwan Electric Power Company's Lake Jitsugetsutan hydroelectric project, alongside cross-reference sheets on capital control and East Asian customs administration.

subfiles.about: A voluntary confidential report detailing the working budget adopted by the Taiwan Government General for the fiscal year 1930-1931 following the Diet's dissolution.
subfiles.summary: This report details the working budget adopted by the Taiwan Government General for fiscal year 1930-1931 following the dissolution of the Imperial Diet. It analyzes ordinary and extraordinary revenues and expenditures totaling 116,505,363 yen, highlighting allocations for police administration, transportation, and public works. The report also discusses political friction between Governor General Ishizuka and Tokyo over proposed administrative reorganizations.
subfiles.title: The Working Budget of Taiwan for the Fiscal Year 1930-1931

subfiles.about: A report on the initial draft of the 1931-1932 fiscal year budget prepared by the Finance Bureau of the Taiwan Government General.
subfiles.summary: Reports the initial draft of Taiwan's 1931-1932 budget totaling 110,000,000 yen, noting retrenchment and the abandonment of several new projects due to reduced surplus.
subfiles.title: Initial Draft of the 1931-1932 Budget of the Government General

subfiles.about: A cross-reference sheet concerning Cabinet approval for a foreign loan sought by the Taiwan Power Company for hydroelectric development.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference note on Cabinet approval for Taiwan Power Company's foreign loan for the Lake Jitsugetsutan hydroelectric project.
subfiles.title: Financial Affairs - Taiwan

subfiles.about: A comprehensive voluntary report on the 1931-1932 budget of the Taiwan Government General as approved by the Overseas Department and Treasury.
subfiles.summary: This voluntary report reviews the Taiwan Government General's approved budget of 114,964,521 yen for fiscal year 1931-1932, reflecting a slight retrenchment due to economic depression. It itemizes appropriations for forty-six new undertakings, including the Sugar Research Institute, Karenko port construction, and riparian works on the Ukei and Sebumbei rivers. The report notes that despite general austerity, substantial capital was committed to key infrastructure and industrial development.
subfiles.title: Budget of the Taiwan Government General for the Fiscal Year 1931-1932

subfiles.summary: Reports an anticipated 10,000,000 yen budget deficit caused by depressed monopoly and railway revenues, prompting administrative retrenchment.
subfiles.title: Deficit in Budget of Government General of Taiwan

subfiles.about: A comprehensive report on the 1932-1933 Taiwan Government General budget approved by the Ministry of Finance at Tokyo.
subfiles.summary: This report outlines the approved 1932-1933 Taiwan Government General budget of 96,104,414 yen, reflecting significant reductions due to the worldwide economic depression and retrenchment policies. It provides a detailed schedule of forty-six new undertakings, encompassing natural gas research, the Sugar Research Institute, railway rolling stock, highway construction, and shipping subsidies. The consul highlights ongoing public works and shipping links that sustain economic ties with Japan and neighboring regions.
subfiles.title: Budget of the Taiwan Government General for the Fiscal Year 1932-1933

subfiles.about: A voluntary report detailing Diet modifications to the 1932-1933 budget of the Taiwan Government General.
subfiles.summary: Details Diet adjustments to Taiwan's 1932-1933 budget, adding funds for commercial aviation, radicalism control, loan interest, and Philippine shipping.
subfiles.title: Revised Budget of the Taiwan Government General for the Fiscal Year 1932-1933

subfiles.about: A comprehensive report detailing the Taiwan Government General's budget for the fiscal year 1933-1934 approved by the Cabinet.
subfiles.summary: This comprehensive report analyzes the 1933-1934 Taiwan budget of 102,772,083 yen approved by the Japanese Cabinet, representing an increase driven by unemployment relief programs. It details fifty-eight specific undertakings covering aboriginal village administration, technical education, chemical experiments, gold production subsidies, and extensive riparian and highway works. The report observes that public development projects across the island continued steadily despite depressed general economic conditions.
subfiles.title: Budget of the Taiwan Government General for the Fiscal Year 1933-1934

subfiles.about: A detailed report analyzing the proposed 1934-1935 budget of the Taiwan Government General following approval by the Japanese Cabinet.
subfiles.summary: This report reviews the Taiwan Government General's 1934-1935 budget of 110,737,283 yen, emphasizing Tokyo's total ban on public loan issues for Taiwan. To compensate, the colonial administration utilized accumulated surpluses to restore four-fifths of originally curtailed new enterprises, including railway expansion, camphor industry buyouts, and highway construction. The report examines policies addressing the rice surplus, encouragement of substitute crops, trade promotion with Manchukuo, and air service preparations.
subfiles.title: Budget of the Taiwan Government General for the Fiscal Year 1934-1935

subfiles.about: An extensive report providing complete revenue and expenditure details from the Official Gazette for the 1934-1935 Taiwan budget.
subfiles.summary: This detailed report presents the final official figures and breakdown of the 1934-1935 Taiwan budget following approval by the Imperial Japanese Diet. It provides line-by-line financial accounting for tax revenues, government monopolies, postal and communication services, transportation enterprises, and multi-year infrastructure commitments. Special attention is given to the government buyout of the Taiwan Camphor Manufacturing Company, harbor expansions at Keelung and Takao, and riparian flood prevention projects.
subfiles.title: Details of Budget of the Taiwan Government General for 1934-1935

subfiles.title: Preliminary Figures of the Budget for 1935-1936
